title: Nvidia's Huang is asked to brief Congress on reported Chinese spy relationship
summary: Nvidia's CEO Jensen Huang is set to address Congress regarding allegations of a potential espionage relationship with China. This follows intelligence findings that were reportedly shared with former President Donald Trump approximately a year prior. The situation raises significant concerns about national security and the implications for the tech industry, particularly as Nvidia plays a crucial role in the global economy.
